verses.1: And David said to his heart, “Now, I will gather together all the people under Shaul’s leadership. There is no good in me anymore; I am trapped in the land of Philistines. Shaul will take me away from here, and I will be captured by him once again. I will be taken away from all the borders of Israel.”
verses.2: David stood up and went ahead. With him was Shechem, a man who was with King Gath.
verses.3: David sat down with Achish in his house. His men were also there. In David’s house were two of his wives: Ahinoam from Jezreel, and Abigail, the daughter of Nabal from Carmel.
verses.4: And he told Shaul that David had run away, and he still hadn’t returned to seek him.
verses.5: And David said to Achish, “If I find favor in your eyes, please give me a place in one of the cities of the kingdom. Let me live there. But why should your servant live in the same city as you?”
verses.6: And that day, the fox gave him the Tzeklag. The Tzeklag was a symbol of kingship among the Jews until that day.
verses.7: And it became so that during the days when David reigned in the land of Philistines, there were twenty-four years.
verses.8: And David and his men went up to the mountains of Israel, to the Geshuri, and to the Gezer. For those lands were now under their control; they had ruled over them since ancient times, from the land of Shur until the land of Egypt.
verses.9: And David struck the land, and no man or woman could live. He took away the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the garments, and everything else. Then he went back to Acis.
verses.10: And Achiš said, “Break up today.” And David said, “On the hills of Judah, and on the hills of Elahmali, and on the hills of Kini.”
verses.11: And neither man nor woman shall live, because David brought about this judgment: that they would not tell us, “David did this and that,” and that his laws should be remembered forever, as long as he ruled in the land of Philistines.
verses.12: And Achišh vowed to David, saying, “The fire will come upon my people in Israel, and I will become a slave forever.”
